decisions.reason: As a yogurt variant very close to the core range, its carrying cost is low and the earlier positive signal still supports keeping it, even though after several years without fresh evidence the option value is lower than in 2019.

Because it was introduced as a flagship cheese and remains tightly aligned with the firm’s established cheese business, management would likely continue it unless later sales data clearly disappointed.
After several years, the learning value of a multi-variant spicy cheese line is largely exhausted and the assortment complexity now outweighs the benefit of keeping this option open.
A mild creamy soft cheese fits mainstream taste and the firm’s capabilities well, so it is still worth retaining despite the absence of new visible success signals.

The washed-rind soft cheese serves a narrower taste niche, and with no new evidence of traction after years on the market management would reallocate resources to stronger core products or new developments.
